mood: Landscape collage-drawing on pale scuffed ground: two disconnected plum loop clusters, a dense left knot with a broad scratched pinch and a sparse right pair. Across an erased corridor, two unequal tiny back-facing skirted fragments stand apart, one touching a loop, one outside; one wears a pale top. Broken red strokes interrupt the gap; low turquoise slants beneath cyan, mint, pink and gray deposits and wiry arcs.
material_language: Matte pale paper-like ground with scuffed, erased-looking openings
Translucent cyan, mint, pink and gray granular deposits
Uneven plum contours crossed by fine scratches and wiry black strokes
Miniature photographic figure fragments with dark shoulders and flared skirt hems
lighting: Even, high-key presentation of a flat layered drawing; preserve pale openings and translucent deposits without dimensional spotlighting or cast shadows.
object_inventory: A broad plum pinched loop junction threaded with scratches and cyan-green traces
negative_constraints: No recreated four-figure lineup, near-identical arrangement, pasted source panel or framed artwork object.
No stretching, forced cropping or padding of the square reference to obtain landscape.
No unrelated landscape, room, horizon, macro texture or palette-only abstraction.
No labels, URLs, text, logos, page chrome, cards, pins, target rings or debug outlines.
No identifiable copied people; retain anonymous back-facing silhouettes, narrow heads, shoulder masses and flared hems.
No additional source-bearing features; subordinate all other motifs without erasing their source-native relationships.
